questions.stem: According to the passage, which two countries were the first to receive medicines under the new WHO platform?
questions.evidence: The first medicines were to be provided to Mongolia and Uzbekistan.
questions.explanation_ko: 새 플랫폼의 첫 약품은 몽골과 우즈베키스탄에 제공될 예정이라고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT given as a reason children with cancer in low-resource settings often die?
options: Problems with the supply of treatments
questions.evidence: These include the use of low-quality medicines, an inability to get correct treatments, or problems with the supply of treatments.
questions.explanation_ko: 저품질 약품, 올바른 치료를 받지 못함, 치료제 공급 문제는 언급되지만 병상 부족은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the large gap between childhood cancer survival rates in poor and wealthy countries?
options: Cancer is more common in wealthy countries than in poorer ones.
Access to quality medicines is likely a major factor in the survival rate gap between rich and poor countries.
Childhood cancer cannot be treated in any low-income country.
The WHO plans to stop treating cancer in wealthy countries.
questions.evidence: The WHO said childhood cancer survival rates in low- and middle-income countries were often below 30 percent. That compares to survival rates of around 80 percent in wealthy nations.
questions.explanation_ko: 저소득국과 부유한 국가 간 생존율 차이가 크다는 점에서, 양질의 의약품 접근성이 그 격차의 주요 원인 중 하나임을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention that St. Jude Children's Research Hospital provided $200 million for the platform's launch?
options: To show the scale of financial commitment behind the program
To explain how hospitals are funded in general
To compare St. Jude to other hospitals
questions.evidence: The U.S. non-profit treatment and research organization provided $200 million for its launch
questions.explanation_ko: 이 금액은 이 프로그램을 뒷받침하는 재정적 헌신의 규모를 보여 주기 위해 언급되었습니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "sustainability" mean in "developing its sustainability – or ability to continue to provide the service - over the longer term"?
options: the ability to keep operating over time
questions.explanation_ko: sustainability는 여기서 장기적으로 서비스를 계속 제공할 수 있는 능력을 의미합니다.

blanks.sentence_ko: 시범 단계에 있는 국가들은 품질이 보장된 소아암 치료제를 끊김 없이 무료로 공급받게 됩니다.
오랫동안 암에 걸린 아이들은 생명을 구하는 약에 접근하지 못했습니다.
이는 아이들이 어디에 살든, 지불 능력이 있든 없든 필요한 약을 제공하는 세계적 운동의 시작입니다.
그는 이 프로그램이 플랫폼을 확대하고 추가 협력 기관을 참여시키고자 한다고 말했다.

key_points: The WHO launched a new platform to provide free cancer medicines to children in low- and middle-income countries, starting with Mongolia and Uzbekistan.
Childhood cancer survival rates in poorer countries are often below 30 percent, compared to about 80 percent in wealthy nations.
The platform, backed by a $200 million commitment from St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, aims to eventually reach 50 countries and up to 120,000 children over five to seven years.
About 400,000 children develop cancer worldwide each year, and about 70 percent of those in low-resource settings die, often due to low-quality medicines or supply problems.
main_idea: The WHO has launched a new platform to provide free, quality-assured cancer medicines to children in low- and middle-income countries, aiming to close the large survival-rate gap with wealthy nations.
restate_sentence: The drug treatments are expected to reach around 5,000 children with cancer this year across at least 30 hospitals in the six countries.
